Why does your phone go dark through sunglasses?
Why does your phone go dark through sunglasses?
Tilt your head,
and the picture usually
comes back.
Light is a wave,
and it can wiggle in any
direction.
Many phone screens only
let out light
that wiggles one way.
Polarized sunglasses are
a filter too.
Worn upright,
they only pass
up-and-down wiggles,
to block the glare off
roads and water.
Line the two filters up,
and the light gets through.
Turn one a quarter turn,
and they cross.
Almost nothing passes.
Your screen never
switched off.
Your glasses just
blocked it.
